# FoxTrading Singapore

> FoxTrading Singapore (trading as ftsgp.com) is a Mexican food importer and distributor based in Singapore, supplying premium fresh produce, frozen foods, meats, seafood, and spirits sourced from certified Mexican growers and producers to restaurants, hotels, retailers, and distributors across Asia-Pacific. Founded in 2016, the company serves clients in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam.

## About

FoxTrading Singapore Pte Ltd bridges Mexican food producers with the Asia-Pacific market. The company sources directly from certified Mexican farms and distilleries, manages cold-chain logistics from Mexico to Singapore, and handles all export documentation. It is registered in Singapore at 16 Raffles Hong Leong Building, Singapore 048581. The site is available in English (en-SG, default) and Spanish for Mexico (es-MX).

## Products & Services

- **Fresh Produce** — Avocados, mangoes, berries, citrus, papaya, and dragon fruit. Over 200 varieties sourced year-round from certified Mexican growers.
- **Frozen Foods & Blends** — IQF fruits, frozen blends, fruit pulps, and frozen vegetables. Flash-frozen at peak ripeness.
- **Specialty Foods** — Guacamole, salsas, avocado oil, agave syrup, hot sauce, and traditional Mexican specialty products.
- **Meat & Seafood** — Premium beef, poultry, pork, lamb, fish, and seafood from certified Mexican establishments with strict quality protocols.
- **Spirits & Beverages** — Authentic tequila, mezcal, craft beer, Mexican wines, whisky, and vodka from renowned distilleries.
- **Logistics & Documentation** — Full cold-chain management (temperature-controlled containers monitored 24/7), phytosanitary certificates, certificates of origin, health certificates, and Singapore SFA/AVA import documentation support.

## Ordering & Logistics

Minimum order quantities vary by category — typically one pallet for frozen goods; fresh produce is negotiable. Standard delivery from Mexico to Singapore is 3–4 weeks by sea freight, with air freight available for urgent orders. Shipments can be consolidated to reduce costs for smaller buyers. Payment is accepted by bank transfer or letter of credit in SGD or USD.
